name: Hilir quarter contacts
goals: Find a local hearing after the conquest changes the chain of authority.
Keep Hilir’s petitions separate from disputes within the Upeh household.
bio: Hilir has its own post-conquest contact in Colascar. A merchant with business on both banks need not inherit either quarter’s quarrels.
notes: fact: Pires and Birch name Colascar in the post-conquest settlement, separately from the Upeh leadership (Pires II, pp. 281–282; Birch III, pp. 166–167)
inference: The appointment neither proves a pre-fall office nor establishes a standing Upeh–Hilir feud (people-factions.md §§2–3)
gameplay: Use this record as an aftermath contact, not a sultanate appointment (people-factions.md §4)
